tagline: 陪第一份工资的年轻人和钱相处的 Agent

mcp.notes: 2026-07-28 requires Mcp-Method header matching body method; tools/call also requires Mcp-Name. confirm_action per-action required fields are published as allOf/if-then in inputSchema; proposals are HMAC-bound to the issuing moneyState digest.

endToEnd.covers: 分配→扣罐→撤销→回看→候选原则→确认→引用→删除,含乐观锁/幂等/proposal 与撤销令牌验签/跨会话 proposal 拒绝/统一错误契约/if-then 与具名 output schema/413/四罐齐全

verification.ci: https://github.com/lessen-xu/BondPup/actions/workflows/ci.yml (job "verify" on every PR; PR #42 was accidentally merged red and PR #43 fixed it the same day)

browser.covers: 危机首击热线/演示原则闭环/未完成入口
browser.note: requires system Edge/Chrome; not in CI

model.selection: env-var based; per-task strong-model mapping via *_MODEL_STRONG; failure/timeout/daily-budget degrades to deterministic mock; whole task shares one 9s deadline (client waits 10s)

safety.inputGate: keyword routing for self_harm / debt_loan / investment / generic_emotion on current input; hard-risk scan (self_harm/debt_loan/investment) additionally covers every model-bound string: principle stories, existing statements, concerns, rich context (recentStories/principles/concerns/item); risky entries are stripped or generation is withheld, so risky text never reaches the model
safety.crisisResponse: fixed copy with 24h helpline 12356, verified at the API layer by contract tests
safety.outputGate: 20-word forbidden list; sentence budget by scene (decision 5 with mandatory three neutral actions, review_note 2, others 3); decompose output gate (forbidden words / length / user perspective); one retry then deterministic fallback; static UI copy scanned in CI
safety.principleGate: first person, <=25 codepoints, evidence must reference reviewed stories, no duplicate evidence ids, hard-risk semantics rejected (self-harm/debt/investment cannot be adopted as principles); retry once then silently withhold (v7.4); demo mode may opt into a deterministic candidate
safety.auditEvents: risk type and rule only, never user text

privacy.storage: browser localStorage only; server persists nothing
